description: Source code for SPL (Secondary Program Loader) block device image loading, supporting FAT, EXT4, and raw image formats, with functions for initializing block devices, reading images, and handling different boot scenarios.

methods.name: spl_get_block_device
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the block device descriptor.

methods.name: block_load_image_fat
methods.description: Loads an image from FAT filesystem.

methods.name: block_load_image_fat_os
methods.description: Loads OS image from FAT filesystem if supported.

methods.name: spl_block_load_image
methods.description: Main function to load the boot image, supporting FAT, EXT4, and raw formats based on configuration.

methods.name: block_load_image_ext4
methods.description: Loads an image from EXT4 filesystem.

methods.name: block_load_image_ext4_os
methods.description: Loads OS image from EXT4 filesystem if supported.

methods.name: block_load_image_raw
methods.description: Loads raw image directly from block device.

methods.name: block_load_image_raw_os
methods.description: Loads OS image from raw block device if supported.
